desc.Adult Leisure Swim: Adult leisure swim is an unstructured swim for those looking to exercise, socialize or relax in the water. This swim is open to persons 16 years of age and older. Lap swimming within the therapy pools may not be permitted based on attendance and size of pool to ensure the safety of patrons. Please check with the lifeguard staff on site if permitted during your swim.
desc.At Play- Fun Skate (10 - 17 yrs): Public ice skating in Mississauga is a fun, casual way to enjoy time on the ice-whether you're gliding solo or skating with friends, it is a great way to enjoy some fun, stay social and build new skills. These sessions are FREE, and they're typically held at indoor arenas or outdoor rinks at city wide arena locations. CSA approved hockey helmet is strongly recommended. You must provide your own skates. Admission standards apply.
desc.Drop In 55+ Hockey Shinny: Unsupervised pick-up hockey for adults 55 years of age and and older. Goalies not provided. Full hockey equipment is mandatory including CSA approved hockey helmet. Facial protection is recommended.Tickets will be sold 30 minutes prior to program start time. All participants must pay for admittance and wear a wristband issued as proof of payment. Please listen and obey facility/program staff at all times.All participants must be in full control. This is a non contact program. Participants must allow one another equitable playing time and adhere to the posted code of conduct. Goalies in full equipment are allowed free admission.
desc.Drop In Adult & Older Adult Skate: Program unsupervvised by patrols. It is recommended that a CSA approved hockey helmet be worn. Only approved skating aids are permitted on the ice. Skate in the approved direction only. No figure skating permitted.
desc.Drop In Ai Chi: Ai Chi is a gentle group exercise program in warm, chest-deep water. It is based on a series of 19 flowing movement patterns similar to Tai Chi. The class begins with breathing exercises and progresses by adding upper body movements, trunk stability challenges and lower body movements. It is designed to increase range of motion and over all mobility while promoting relaxation and a healthy mind-body relationship. Excellent program for those with Fibromyalgia.
desc.Drop In Aqua Yoga & Toning: Aqua Yoga and Toning is a class that blends the benefits of aqua yoga combining the flow of various yoga postures and utilize the power of water to strengthen your muscles, increase mobility and balance.
desc.Drop In Aquafitness: Aquafitness is a low impact workout using the resistance of the water for a great workout. Classes include warm-up, cardio, muscle conditioning and stretching. A variety of equipment is used including; water belts, aquatic resistance equipment and noodles etc.
desc.Drop In Aquafitness Boot Camp: Aquatic fitness Boot Camp is a low impact, high energy class inspired by military style circuits. Class includes cardio and muscle conditioning including water running with floatation belts and various types of resistance equipment. Participants must be comfortable in deep water. Prerequisite: Must be able to swim 25 m and be comfortable in deep water.
desc.Drop In Aquafitness For Women: This program is designed for women/girl participants with a woman instructor. The pool area and viewing areas will be restricted to women/girls only (except in an emergency). Men/ boys have access to common areas hallways and office areas. Aquafitness is a low impact workout using the resistance of the water for a great workout. Classes include warm-up, cardio, muscle conditioning and stretching. A variety of equipment is used including; water belts, aquatic resistance equipment and noodles etc.
desc.Drop In Badminton: This is an un-organized, pay as you go badminton drop-in that is open to youth and adults. Space is limited. This drop-in will be run at a first come first serve basis.
desc.Drop In Cardio and Tone: This workout consists of options for high and low impact cardio moves, followed by a toning segment which may include the use of resistance equipment.
desc.Drop In Chi Fusion: Blending movements inspired by Tai Chi, yoga, Pilates, Barre, and fitness. This class provides a gentle yet effective workout for balance, flexibility, core, and mindfulness.
desc.Drop In Deep End Aquafitness: Classes are held in deep water reducing any impact on your joints using buoyant belts for added support. Deep water classes are ideal for developing core strength and balance. Class design will include warm-up, cardio muscle conditioning and stretching. Prerequisite: must be able to swim 25 m and be comfortable in deep water.
desc.Drop In Figure Skating: Equipment Requirements: Hockey skates are not permitted. Figure skates must be worn. Skill level: This drop-in program is intended for experienced figure skaters. Skaters will practice figure skating elements (jumps, spins, and footwork). For safety reasons, entry level skaters are not permitted to participate in this program. Description: This is an unsupervised drop-in program intended for figure skaters. Periodic visits will be made to ensure participants are adhering to the equipment requirements and general guidelines. Absolutely no private or commercial training on or in the City of Mississauga recreation facilities during City run public programs (including arenas).
desc.Drop In Guts & Butts H2O: Guts and Butts H20 is a program in the pool that focuses on toning and strengthening your back, hip and abdominal muscles. The perfect complement to your high energy water workout.
desc.Drop In Hip & Knee: Hip and Knee provides participants with exercises specifically designed for those with hip / knee joint degeneration and injuries or who are preparing or recovering from hip or knee surgery. The low impact class will focus on range of motion for the joints, muscle conditioning, balance and postural training. This class is held in a warm water pool.
desc.Drop In Hockey Shinny (18+): Unsupervised pick-up hockey for adults 18 years of age and and older. Goalies not provided. Full hockey equipment is mandatory including CSA approved hockey helmet. Facial protection is recommended.Tickets will be sold 30 minutes prior to program start time. All participants must pay for admittance and wear a wristband issued as proof of payment. Please listen and obey facility/program staff at all times.All participants must be in full control. This is a non contact program. Participants must allow one another equitable playing time and adhere to the posted code of conduct. Goalies in full equipment are allowed free admission.
desc.Drop In Hockey Stick & Puck With Adult (: Looking to build confidence on the ice, improve your skating, or practice your stickhandling skills? Stick and Puck provides a fun and welcoming drop-in environment for participants of all skill levels to develop their hockey skills at their own pace. Participants are welcome to wear full hockey equipment or goalie equipment while practicing skating, puck control, and stickhandling. This program is intended for individual skill development only. Scrimmages, games, and shinny play are not permitted. Required Equipment Skates and a CSA-approved hockey helmet are required for all participants. Participants ages 3 to 13 years must wear a cage or visor. A cage or visor is strongly recommended for participants and guardians 18 years and older. A maximum of two goalies in full equipment may use the nets during the program. Parent & Guardian Information Participants under 10 years of age must be accompanied by a parent or guardian who remains on the ice or at rink side for supervision throughout the program. Participants 10 to 13 years of age may participate independently and do not require a parent or guardian to remain on the ice or at rink side. For the safety and well-being of younger participants, parents and guardians of participants 10 to 13 years of age are encouraged to remain in the facility during the program in case assistance is needed. Parents or guardians supervising from rink side are not required to pay admission. Admission standards apply.
desc.Drop In Low and Tone: A low impact cardio class followed by strength training for a full body workout.
desc.Drop In Low Impact Gentle: This slower paced low impact class incorporates a longer warm-up, segments of cardio and strength training, followed by an extended cool down. Gentle on the joints.
desc.Drop In Meditation: Meditation is a grounding practice that helps to quiet the mind and develop practical skills to improve your well-being. Through mindful movement, focus and breath work, regular practice can help to improve your ability to manage day to day stress, be more balanced and sleep better. Bring a blanket or wear layers. No experience required.
desc.Drop In Mobility and Stability: Improve your posture and balance through gentle cardio and resistance routines with an emphasis on mobility and core stability. Stand tall and walk with confidence!
desc.Drop In Oh My Aching Body: Oh My Aching Body is recommended for those with arthritis, fibromyalgia, osteoporosis and Parkinson's disease and would benefit from exercise in warm water. Exercises selected work all the joints and muscles of the body in a safe and enjoyable environment. This class is held in the warm water therapeutic pool.
desc.Drop In Oh My Aching Body For Women: This program is designed for women/girl participants with a woman instructor. The pool area and viewing areas will be restricted to women/girls only (except in an emergency). Men/ boys have access to common areas hallways and office areas. Oh My Aching Body is recommended for those with arthritis, fibromyalgia, osteoporosis and Parkinson's disease and would benefit from exercise in warm water. Exercises selected work all the joints and muscles of the body in a safe and enjoyable environment. This class is held in the warm water therapeutic pool.
desc.Drop In Oh My Aching Body-Advanced: Oh My Aching Body Advanced provides the same full body workout and stretch of our regular 'Oh My Aching Body' but at a more intense level and with a cardio component. Excellent for those with arthritis, fibromyalgia, osteoporosis and other joint disorders and are already for a more advanced program in the warm water.
desc.Drop In Older Adult Basketball: Join an unstructured yet supervised pay-as-you-go game of pick up Basketball
desc.Drop In Pilates: A full body conditioning class that focuses on abdominal/core stability while providing a mind-body workout. Emphasis is placed on the breath, body alignment, control and form to aid in improved posture and mobility.
desc.Drop In Pilates Gentle: A full body conditioning class that focuses on abdominal/core stability while providing a mind-body workout. Emphasis is placed on the breath, body alignment, control and form to aid in improved posture and mobility. With the assistance of blocks, straps and chairs, students are encouraged to work in their own range of abilities.
desc.Drop In Shoulder, Back & Core H20: Shoulder, Back and Core will focus on good postural alignment, functional walking patterns, improving range of motion, challenging core, strengthening back muscles and effective shoulder stabilization. This class is held in the warm water therapeutic pool.
desc.Drop In Stretch Class: This class uses various stretching techniques that will help maintain or improve overall flexibility.
desc.Drop In Table Tennis Adult: This is un-organized, pay-as-you-go table tennis that is open to adults. Space is limited.
desc.Drop In Total Body Toning: This full body strength workout using various types of equipment and body weight exercises. No cardio component.
desc.Drop In Total Body Workout: Full body workout using various cardio formats and strength training exercises.
desc.Drop In Volleyball Low Int: A program for participants who are not new to the sport of volleyball, know the basics and are interested in further developing their skills.
desc.Drop In Warm Water Strength Training: This full body workout in a warm water therapeutic pool will include muscle strengthening, conditioning and flexibility exercises for the legs, arms, shoulders and core. Suitable for participants who are looking for a more intense program in warm water.
desc.Drop In Yoga: Regular practice of Yoga can improve muscle tone and increase flexibility. Each class uses a variety of stretching principles and movements combined with breathing and relaxation techniques.
desc.Drop In Yoga Gentle: Regular practice of Yoga can improve muscle tone and increase flexibility. With the assistance of blocks, straps and chairs, participants are encouraged to work in their own range of abilities. Appropriate for individuals recovering from an injury or with restricted joint flexibility.
desc.Drop In Yoga Power: Regular practice of Yoga can improve muscle tone and increase flexibility. Power Yoga is a more challenging yoga class which incorporates a series of athletic postures that will develop your balance, co-ordination, strength and flexibility.
desc.Drop In Yoga Therapeutic H2O: Yoga Therapeutic H20 is beneficial for those recovering from or living with an injury or illness. It is held in the warm water pool and blends gentle yoga postures with guided meditation and breathing. This class is ideal for improving range of motion, balance, postural alignment, muscle conditioning and mobility.
desc.Drop In Yoga Yin: This healing practice of yoga is slower and more meditative. Poses are held for a longer period of time to stretch and lengthen deeper connective tissue resulting in reduced muscle tension, increased flexibility and energy. Please bring a yoga mat and wear layers to keep warm
desc.Drop In Youth Sauga At Play Basketball: FREE youth basketball drop-in. This unstructured basketball program is open to youth. Space is limited and participation is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Check your local Community Centre for the schedule.
desc.Drop In Youth Sauga At Play Chill Zone: FREE youth drop in chill zone. This unstructured program is available to youth to play games, finish homework and hangout with friends. Space is limited and participation is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Check your local Community Centre for the schedule.
desc.Drop In Youth Sauga At Play Swim: Sauga At Play Swim is a free, drop-in, afterschool structured recreational swim for 10 to 18 year-olds. This inclusive aquatic program gives youth the option to practice swim technique, stroke development, and endurance with a swim instructor. Aquatic rock wall will also be available during this time. This aquatic program compliments the Sauga At Play program by giving youth the choice to learn new skills that they may not have the opportunity otherwise. Please refer to the swim admission standards to help you have a safe and positive swim experience.
desc.Drop In Youth Sauga At Play Volleyball: FREE youth volleyball drop-in. This unstructured volleyball program is open to youth. Space is limited and participation is available on a first-come, first-served basis. Check your local Community Centre for the schedule.
desc.Drop In Zumba\u00ae: This fitness dance class combines Latin and international music with slow and fast paced moves. Enjoy this inspiring up beat workout.
desc.Drop In Zumba\u00ae Gold: This fitness dance class modifies the moves and pace of the original Zumba to suit the needs of the active older adult and those new to Zumba. It's easy to do, effective and most of all, fun!
desc.Drop In Zumba\u00ae Toning: This fitness dance class combines low and high intensity dance moves for an interval-style dance fitness class that incorporates weighted toning sticks or equipment during the Zumba workout.
desc.Fun & Lane Swim For Women & Girls: This program is designed for both girls and/or women with female lifeguards. Therapy pool will be an unstructured recreational swim for all ages. Main pool will be available for lane swimming. The pool area and viewing areas will be restricted to women and girls only (except in an emergency). Men/boys have access to common areas, hallways, and office areas. Please refer to the swim admission standards to help you have a safe and positive swim experience.
desc.Fun Skate: Tickets will be sold 30 minutes prior to program start time. ALL Participants must pay for admittance and wear a wristband issued from Customer Service, as proof of payment. The wristband must be worn while on the ice.Please listen to and obey facility/program staff at all times. CSA Approved hockey helmet is strongly recommended.Food & beverages are not permitted on the ice.Only approved skating aids and ice skates are permitted on the ice. Skate in the approved direction only. All participants must be in full control. This is a non-contact program. Rest periods must be taken in the players benches. Individuals must adhere to the posted code of conduct.
desc.Fun Swim: Fun swim is an unstructured recreational swim for all ages. Please refer to the swim admission standards to help you have a safe and positive swim experience.
desc.Lane Swim: Lane swim is a structured swim for continuous 25m lap swimming. Pools are divided to allow for a circular pattern while swimming. Lane division will be based on the pace of the swimmers. Swimmers need to be comfortable in deep water and are required to swim continuously within the lane. Swimmers may be required to complete a swim test. Admission standards apply.
desc.Parent & Tot Swim: Parent and Tot swim is an unstructured recreational swim for preschool children (6 years and under) accompanied by a parent/guardian. Please refer to the swim admission standards to help you have a safe and positive swim experience.
desc.Therapeutic Time: Therapeutic time is dedicated pool time to do your prescribed exercises for rehabilitation/post rehabilitation in an unstructured swim in the therapeutic pool. This swim does not have an instructor, specialized therapeutic equipment is only available during this time. Verified Health Care Providers must identify themselves to Customer Service staff upon entry.
desc.Drop In 20/20/20: In three efficient segments, this class offers a full body workout that flies by. Get variety and challenge from two types of cardio followed by conditioning/toning using a variety of resistance tools and body weight.
desc.Drop In Adult Basketball: Join an unstructured yet supervised pay-as-you-go game of pick up Basketball
desc.Drop In Boot Camp: Combines cardio and conditioning training in a high-energy, more military style format - basic and functional drills and skills. We provide the circuit, the motivation and the modifications (progressions and regressions) so that you can choose your own options and intensity.
desc.Drop In Dance Fit Class: This is a combination of high energy & routines resulting in a fun cardio workout. The instructor will use a variety of music and dance styles to keep you motivated and moving throughout the class.
desc.Drop In Fitness Boxing: Train like a boxer with this high-energy workout combining boxing fundamentals, strength training and cardio. Improve endurance, coordination and confidence while learning stance, footwork, defense and punch combinations. Each session includes a warm up, technical drills and strength exercises to boost power and agility. No sparring and no contact permitted.
desc.Drop In High Intensity Interval Training: This class is a form of interval training with alternating periods of intense exercise with short recovery periods.

desc.Drop In Seniors' Centre Pickleball: A racquet sport that combines elements of badminton, tennis and table tennis. This game is played with a hard paddle and a whiffle ball. Beginners Welcome. A valid membership to the Mississauga Seniors' Centre is required. For further information on this activity, please contact the Mississauga Seniors' Centre, 905-615-4810.

desc.Drop In Stronger & Steadier Level 2: This course is going to be used as a tracking system for drop-in participants to the Stronger and Steadier Level 2 course.
desc.Drop In Fit Wall Workout: A full body workout using vertical training offering cardiovascular, functional and metabolic strength training.
desc.Bollywood Fitness: This class includes easy-to-follow moves inspired by Hindi dance and Bollywood style hip-hop combined with toning and conditioning for a full body workout.
desc.Boot Camp: Combines cardio and conditioning training in a high-energy, more military style format - basic and functional drills and skills. We provide the circuit, the motivation and the modifications (progressions and regressions) so that you can choose your own options and intensity.
desc.Buttocks Legs and Core: A toning class that targets the lower body along with the core (including abs and back). You will use various fitness training techniques along with a mix of equipment and body weight exercises.
desc.Drop In Cycle and Stretch: Set your own pace and intensity while enjoying the energy, motivation, music, and instruction. This class features a variety of cycling drills, including sprints, hill climbs, endurance intervals, and technique-focused training followed by a guided stretch to support flexibility, mobility, and recovery
desc.Drop In Cycle with Yoga: Enjoy an indoor group cycle class that combines music and drills followed by a yoga/stretch segment.
desc.Drop In TRX and Kettlebell Circuit Class: This class consists of cardio work with circuits using the TRX suspension system and kettlebells for an overall workout and core strength. The TRX system can be adapted to challenge all participants and fitness levels.
